sentence: This project builds mouse models with human B cells to help design and test vaccines against HIV.
This project studies how the brain clears protein waste and how that relates to amyloid, tau and memory in Alzheimer's disease.
This project tests whether magnetic resonance imaging of the kidney can show chronic scarring in people with chronic kidney disease without a biopsy.
This project studies how cells control the movement of proteins and membranes between different places inside the cell.
This project builds an imaging tool combining ultrasound and photoacoustic imaging to tell aggressive prostate cancer from non-aggressive prostate cancer.
This project builds a faster and cheaper way to make transgenic nonhuman primates for research.
This project builds a sensor made of a perovskite material for imaging gamma ray emitters.
This project develops a test using cell-free DNA methylation to find colon, gastric, liver and lung cancers early.
This project studies how brain stress signals change one brain region and drive drinking during alcohol withdrawal in rats.
This project studies how lung cancer detection, treatment and survival differ for older adults between private insurance plans and traditional Medicare.
This project builds AI systems to help map how Type 1 diabetes progresses.
This project studies whether social and socioeconomic stress speeds up biological aging and worsens cancer outcomes in people with HIV.
This project develops methods to analyze large genomic datasets to find the genetic causes of alcohol use disorder.
This project builds computer tools to predict cancer-specific neoepitopes that T-cell immunotherapy could target in solid tumors.
This project uses mice to study how a malaria infection affects how well the Ebola virus vaccine works.
This project studies the structure of enzymes in cell membranes and how they interact with lipids and their substrates.
This project studies how the machinery encoded by mobile genetic elements works and is built in microbes.
This project develops a low-cost test to detect human papillomavirus infection for screening cervical cancer.
This project studies how a mitochondrial protein drives epigenetic reprogramming and helps pancreatic cancer metastasis.
This project studies what signals create inflammatory fibroblasts after lung injury and how they affect lung inflammation and fibrosis.
